project_name: G-14 Aether Wave Helmet Diegetic HUD Simulator
design_context: Diegetic Sci-Fi Sci-Tech HUD Simulation & Technical Developer Tool
theme: Dark, Cinematic, Diegetic - Near-black dark background with cyan holographic graphics, warning red alerts, and sacred geometry gold accents

typography.heading_font: Share Tech Mono, Rajdhani, Orbitron, Space Mono, monospace
typography.body_font: Share Tech Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace
typography.sublabel_font: Noto Sans JP, Japanese monospace fallback

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-mono tracking-widest uppercase
scale.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-mono tracking-wider uppercase
scale.label: text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400/70

visual_enhancers.visor_vignette: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 50%, rgba(2,6,12,0.7) 85%, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 100%)

layouts.visor_view: Full screen 100vh canvas/SVG layout with HUD overlay frame, scanlines toggle, curvature effect, and responsive corner HUD modules
layouts.control_drawer: Slide-out or collapsible right panel with sliders (Aether frequency, Cymatic resonance, Target distance, Threat level), preset buttons (Calm/Nominal, Combat/Active, Overload/Critical), and HUD element toggles
layouts.data_feed: Real-time dynamic JSON state reader displaying current helmet telemetry, target lock coordinates, EEG spectral density, and IMU vector
layouts.unreal_integration_page: Developer export hub with tabbed Unreal Engine C++ / Blueprints starter code, HLSL shader snippets, step-by-step HUD setup guide, copy & download options

hud_modules.name: 01 STASIS METER EEG
hud_modules.description: Multi-band brainwave frequency monitor (Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma) with real-time dynamic canvas waveform, neural stability score, and Japanese sub-label Stasis Sync status

hud_modules.name: 02 DYNAMIC COMPASS IMU
hud_modules.description: Horizontal rolling heading strip (0° to 360°) with pitch/roll attitude indicators, cardinal markers (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW), and real-time gyro degree readout

hud_modules.name: 03 ENTITY SILHOUETTE TRACKING
hud_modules.description: Interactive bounding box brackets tracking threat/neutral entities in 2D/3D visor space with distance readouts, velocity vectors, target identification code, and locks

hud_modules.name: 04 CYMATIC RADAR CHLADNI
hud_modules.description: Chladni resonance pattern generator rendering dynamic mathematical vibration node figures based on Aether Frequency sliders

hud_modules.name: 05 LISSAJOUS TARGETING & METATRON'S CUBE
hud_modules.description: Dual-mode reticle switching dynamically between Lissajous parametric curve loops during search/scan and Metatron's Sacred Geometry Cube in locked stable phase

motion_and_interactions.continuous_animation: Smooth requestAnimationFrame loops for EEG waveforms, radar sweep, Lissajous curves, and subtle HUD float
motion_and_interactions.state_transitions: 0.3s cubic-bezier ease-out transitions between Nominal, Combat, and Overload warning states
motion_and_interactions.overload_effects: Rapid red flashing borders, chromatic glitch shift, corrupted ASCII stream alerts, emergency audio alert toggle
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive HUD brackets expand and highlight cyan (#00f0ff) or gold (#e5c158) with glow effect on hover

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: High contrast cyan and gold text against #05070a dark background meeting WCAG AA standards
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All key controls, buttons, toggles, sliders, HUD sections, and code copy buttons MUST include clear data-testid attributes in kebab-case format

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, highly cinematic, interactive G-14 Aether Wave Helmet Diegetic HUD Simulator.
Implement full-screen HUD visor simulation with toggleable scanline filter, visor curvature option, and grid overlays.
Include all 5 diegetic HUD panels: Stasis Meter EEG, Dynamic Compass IMU, Entity Silhouette Tracking, Cymatic Radar Chladni, and Lissajous / Metatron's Cube targeting.
Include interactive control drawer/panel with Aether frequency slider, resonance slider, threat slider, preset buttons (Nominal, Combat, Overload), and HUD layer toggles.
Provide live JSON data stream component showing real-time helmet telemetry.
Include dedicated Unreal Engine Starter Code tab with C++ / Blueprint guidance, copy to clipboard, and code download feature.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated verification.
Ensure zero transparent dropdowns or unreadable text overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic inter typography for main headings; use Share Tech Mono/Rajdhani/monospace for HUD fonts. Ensure full mobile and desktop responsiveness. Avoid static components - add smooth animations to waveforms, radar, reticles, and compass. Provide clear feedback for all interactive controls with data-testid attributes.
